sourceNote: 已整理原文件断行与明显字符错误；译文按所供真题内容编写。 本篇第 2 段的 “dangerous goals” 疑有转录误差，暂按原文件保留。

paragraphs.en: Two years ago, Rupert Murdoch’s daughter, Elisabeth, spoke of the “unsettling dearth of integrity across so many of our institutions”. Integrity had collapsed, she argued, because of a collective acceptance that the only “sorting mechanism” in society should be profit and the market. But “it’s us, human beings, we the people who create the society we want, not profit.”
paragraphs.zh: 两年前，鲁珀特·默多克的女儿伊丽莎白谈到，“我们的众多机构普遍缺乏诚信，令人不安”。她认为，诚信之所以崩塌，是因为大家共同接受了这样一种观念：社会唯一的“筛选机制”应当是利润和市场。但“创造我们所希望的社会的是我们，是人类，是我们这些人，而不是利润。”

paragraphs.en: Driving her point home, she continued: “It’s increasingly apparent that the absence of purpose, of a moral language within government, media or business could become one of the most dangerous goals for capitalism and freedom.” This same absence of moral purpose was wounding companies such as News International, she thought, making it more likely that it would lose its way as it had with widespread illegal telephone hacking.
paragraphs.zh: 为进一步阐明观点，她继续说道：“越来越明显的是，政府、媒体或企业内部缺乏宗旨、缺乏道德话语，可能成为资本主义和自由最危险的目标之一。”她认为，同样的道德宗旨缺失正在伤害新闻国际集团这样的公司，使其更容易迷失方向，正如它曾经进行大规模非法电话窃听时那样。

paragraphs.en: As the hacking trial concludes – finding guilty one ex-editor of the News of the World, Andy Coulson, for conspiring to hack phones, and finding his predecessor, Rebekah Brooks, innocent of the same charge – the wider issue of dearth of integrity still stands. Journalists are known to have hacked the phones of up to 5,500 people. This is hacking on an industrial scale, as was acknowledged by Glenn Mulcaire, the man hired by the News of the World in 2001 to be the point person for phone hacking. Others await trial. This long story still unfolds.
paragraphs.zh: 随着窃听案审判结束——《世界新闻报》前主编安迪·库尔森被认定犯有合谋窃听电话罪，而他的前任丽贝卡·布鲁克斯在同一指控下被判无罪——诚信缺失这一更广泛的问题依然存在。已知有多达5500人的电话遭到记者窃听。格伦·马尔凯尔也承认，这是一种产业化规模的窃听；他于2001年受雇于《世界新闻报》，担任电话窃听的主要负责人。其他涉案人员仍在等待审判。这一漫长事件还在继续发展。

paragraphs.en: In many respects, the dearth of moral purpose frames not only the fact of such widespread phone hacking but the terms on which the trial took place. One of the astonishing revelations was how little Rebekah Brooks knew of what went on in her newsroom, how little she thought to ask and the fact that she never inquired how the stories arrived. The core of her successful defence was that she knew nothing.
paragraphs.zh: 在许多方面，道德宗旨的缺失不仅构成大规模电话窃听这一事实的背景，也决定了此次审判展开的方式。令人震惊的披露之一是，丽贝卡·布鲁克斯对自己编辑部里发生的事情知之甚少，几乎没有想到去过问，而且从未询问新闻报道是如何得到的。她成功辩护的核心，就是她一无所知。

paragraphs.en: In today’s world, it has become normal that well-paid executives should not be accountable for what happens in the organisations that they run. Perhaps we should not be so surprised. For a generation, the collective doctrine has been that the sorting mechanism of society should be profit. The words that have mattered are efficiency, flexibility, shareholder value, business-friendly, wealth generation, sales, impact and, in newspapers, circulation. Words degraded to the margin have been justice, fairness, tolerance, proportionality and accountability.
paragraphs.zh: 在当今世界，高薪管理人员竟然不必对其所管理机构中发生的事情负责，这已成为常态。也许我们不该如此惊讶。一代人以来，人们共同信奉的教条一直是：社会的筛选机制应当是利润。备受重视的词语是效率、灵活性、股东价值、亲商、创造财富、销售额、影响力，以及报业中的发行量。而被贬到边缘的词语，则是正义、公平、宽容、适度和问责。

paragraphs.en: The purpose of editing the News of the World was not to promote reader understanding, to be fair in what was written or to betray any common humanity. It was to ruin lives in the quest for circulation and impact. Ms Brooks may or may not have had suspicions about how her journalists got their stories, but she asked no questions, gave no instructions – nor received traceable, recorded answers.
paragraphs.zh: 编辑《世界新闻报》的目的，不是增进读者的理解，不是在报道中保持公正，也不是流露任何共同的人性，而是为了追求发行量和影响力去毁掉他人的生活。布鲁克斯女士或许怀疑过、也或许从未怀疑过她的记者获取新闻的方式，但她既不提问，也不作指示——更没有收到过可追溯、有记录的答复。
